explainer_content.short_definition: Crooners and standards interpreters where phrasing, arrangement, and repertoire are the main evidence.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Sinatra, Fitzgerald, Holiday, Nat King Cole, and peers connect the Great American Songbook to jazz, cabaret, film, and adult pop memory.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It preserves the pre-rock vocabulary of pop charisma: timing, tone, repertoire, and orchestration.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The singer often interprets an existing song, so the distinction lives in phrasing and arrangement rather than original songwriting.
